content:
中國的 Apple Watch 用戶可以在本週末參加下一屆「全民健身日」挑戰，獲取虛擬獎勵。

According to upcoming fitness challenge hints, participating in the Apple Watch challenge requires completing a 20-minute workout on Saturday, August 8.

This event is exclusive to China, as the date is the country's National Fitness Day each year.

Upon completing the challenge, users can earn four animated stickers on iOS and a virtual medal within the Fitness app.

Apple regularly hosts activity challenges around the world to encourage Apple Watch users to experience different forms of exercise.

The newly released Apple Watch Series 11 is currently priced from $299.

Make the most of your Apple products.
